environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on a standard EC2 instance running Ubuntu 22.04. The application runs as the 'deploy' user with write access to /opt/app/storage/ and /opt/app/tmp/. The container runs with default Docker capabilities. Nginx reverse proxy forwards all multipart uploads directly to Puma. No filesystem isolation beyond standard Linux permissions. The deploy user has write access to the application directory tree.

config.filesystem: ext4, no read-only mounts, app directory writable
